item.title: Two arrested in Rajgangpur for operating mule accounts linked to cyber fraud
item.description: Rajgangpur: On charges of operating mule bank accounts linked to organised cyber fraud, the Rajgangpur Police have arrested two individuals and forwarded them to court. During the investigation, police found three bank accounts at HDFC Bank, Rajgangpur, in the names of Abdul Quadir and M. Faiyaz Raza, which showed heavy suspicious transactions. item.description: Cuttack: The disappearance of gold jewellery belonging to an inmate at the Choudwar Jail in Cuttack district has taken a dramatic turn, with Jail Superintendent Sujit Raul paying ₹1.9 lakh to the complainant as compensation based on the current market value of gold. item.title: Rajya Sabha elections in Odisha to be held on March 16 as ECI issues poll schedule
item.description: Bhubaneswar: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has announced the schedule for the Rajya Sabha elections in Odisha, with polling slated for March 16, 2026. As per the notification, the process will begin with the issuance of the notification on February 26. The last date for filing nominations is March 5, while scrutiny of nominations will be taken up on March 6. Candidates will be allowed to withdraw their nominations till March 9.
